meanings.en: to recall, to try to remember, to reminisce
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'поминать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to recall, to remember', paired with 'вспомнить'.

examples.text: Я так вспоминаю. Значит, машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: I'm trying to recall it. So I wrecked the car, then?
I am just recalling old stories.

meanings.note: 'вспомни' = remember (that) . Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'помнить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remember, to recall', paired with 'вспоминать'.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (root 'гулять'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to right'.

examples.text: Денис, а вы сейчас хотите пойти погулять?
examples.trans: Denis, do you want to go for a walk right now?

examples.text: Сеня, что-то совсем не похоже, что у него горе.
examples.trans: Senya, it does not look at all like he is grieving.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: + с + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'знакомиться'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to meet, to get acquainted', paired with 'знакомиться'.

examples.text: А как вы с ней познакомились?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'стоянно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'сить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to ask (for)', paired with 'попросить'.

examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
